scope: Organization-neutral release closeout for the 10-week plan and 48 blocking items.

status_vocabulary.implemented_tested: Code/configuration exists and component checks passed; release gate may still be open.
status_vocabulary.implemented_unverified: Code/configuration exists but required acceptance evidence is missing.
status_vocabulary.planned: Required implementation or evidence has not been delivered.
status_vocabulary.blocked: A release-blocking gate cannot close with current evidence.

items.description: Choose native PDF extraction, OCR, or vision processing based on document quality and cost.
items.acceptance: Comparison for short documents, long documents, and scanned tables, with measured processing cost and failure modes.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Assign each source to retrieval, a typed tool, or exclusion according to authority, freshness, and permissions.
items.acceptance: Source-mechanism matrix in [source-authority.md](source-authority.md), verified against fixtures.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Build a small first evaluation that can fail for a concrete defect.
items.acceptance: Labeled fixtures, assertions, thresholds, and an intentionally broken implementation that fails.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Justify supervised listing classifiers using label quality and stable categories.
items.acceptance: Label audit, temporal holdout, leakage analysis, and comparison with prompting.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Enforce access below model-generated arguments.
items.acceptance: Endpoint signatures, database roles, and a reachable/blocked resource matrix.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Prevent retrieved instructions from enabling forbidden actions.
items.acceptance: Tool inventory, execution boundaries, and adversarial capability-reachability tests.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Define exactly what “wrong” means for each capability.
items.acceptance: Sampling frame, grading rubric, exclusions, reviewer effort, and disagreement handling.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Set input, output, retry, and escalation budgets before model execution.
items.acceptance: Per-workflow token arithmetic and an observable routing policy.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Make an unauthorized retrieval or stale answer reconstructable.
items.acceptance: Trace fields, source revisions, retention policy, and a detector query.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Choose fixed workflows and isolate any bounded discretionary step.
items.acceptance: Ordered execution sequence, iteration limits, and terminal failure behavior.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Diagnose whether disappointing results arise from retrieval, generation, product design, or unrealistic goals.
items.acceptance: Stratified trace review, user-edit analysis, and a remediation branch for each finding.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Prevent prompt changes from silently increasing cost or reducing quality.
items.acceptance: Versioned prompts, paired evaluations, merge gates, and an audited override mechanism.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Optimize the stage actually responsible for latency.
items.acceptance: Stage timings, ranked interventions, and quality checks attached to each experiment.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Choose retraining, prompt changes, escalation, or abstention from observed error patterns.
items.acceptance: Independently labeled holdout and error distribution, including rare cases.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Make uploads and jobs survive disconnection, refresh, and process failure.
items.acceptance: State machine, idempotency behavior, and restart/replay tests.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Store operational results, revisions, evidence, and feedback with appropriate lifetimes.
items.acceptance: Entity model, indexes, access patterns, and retention schedule.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Keep production credentials outside developer and coding-agent environments.
items.acceptance: Credential provisioning/rotation process and network-access verification.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Select the smallest architecture that satisfies the chosen scale and private profile.
items.acceptance: Component diagram and deferred components with measurable introduction triggers.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Compare colocated vectors, dedicated search, and lexical-only retrieval.
items.acceptance: Operational cost, consistency, recall, and workload benchmark comparison.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Design useful waiting, navigation, retry, cancellation, and failure states.
items.acceptance: UI state table linked to durable backend job states.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Bound parser and renderer execution by network, filesystem, credentials, and resources.
items.acceptance: Containment configuration and tests that attempt prohibited access.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Size concurrency and define visible behavior during throttling.
items.acceptance: Arrival-rate arithmetic, bounded queues, and overload tests.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Reassess component boundaries when deployment independence or scaling fails.
items.acceptance: Dependency measurements and explicit keep/split/recombine criteria.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Change schemas and search generations without losing permissions or evidence.
items.acceptance: Expand/backfill/validate/switch/retire sequence with reconciliation checks.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Prevent test growth from making verification impractical.
items.acceptance: Test-duration profile, duplication analysis, and a CI runtime budget.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Specify expensive-to-change contracts before implementation while leaving cosmetic details flexible.
items.acceptance: Bounded implementation briefs and a list of deliberately deferred details.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Make source authority, authorization, and workflow boundaries discoverable.
items.acceptance: Concise module map and entry-point documentation.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Review behavior and consequential boundaries before presentation details.
items.acceptance: Review sequence prioritizing access, writes, exports, and source correctness.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Keep standing repository guidance short, actionable, and maintained.
items.acceptance: Proposed instruction content, explicit exclusions, and an owner role.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Decompose work into independently verifiable changes.
items.acceptance: Task dependency map and a closing test for every work package.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Enforce coding-agent permissions through the environment.
items.acceptance: Allowed operations, human-controlled operations, and unreachable production resources.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Allocate review attention with mechanical risk classification.
items.acceptance: Rules based on security paths, migrations, model changes, and periodic sampling.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Separate implementation from independent security verification.
items.acceptance: Ownership split and adversarial cases produced outside the implementation work.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Turn recurring mistakes into enforceable checks.
items.acceptance: Chosen lint, contract test, or authorization property, with its placement in the development loop.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Detect work that passes tests while violating architectural intent.
items.acceptance: Dependency checks forbidding bypasses of authorization and typed query services.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Use parallel coding agents only when integration work remains manageable.
items.acceptance: Isolation and merge protocol, shared decision record, and a measured stop condition.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Test invariants beyond the attack examples already known.
items.acceptance: Independently generated attacks, capability restrictions, and production detection.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Test whether users’ tasks are answerable from available data and whether assistance saves time.
items.acceptance: Falsifiable assumptions and short task-observation studies.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Make demonstrations real where uncertainty matters.
items.acceptance: Real-versus-simulated inventory and the hypothesis each demonstration tests.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Evaluate cost relative to completed useful work and control unexplained increases.
items.acceptance: Cost per accepted answer/draft and comparison with measured user effort.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Treat unexpected usage as both a risk signal and a possible product need.
items.acceptance: Usage observation, immediate mitigation, and a small validation experiment.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Decide what to build, adopt, and defer when usage expands.
items.acceptance: Build/adopt/defer table protecting evidence quality and the user-feedback loop.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Recommend continuation, redirection, or stopping using separate value, quality, and risk decisions.
items.acceptance: Decision memo with measurable continuation and stop conditions.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Attach important measurements to workflows the team already performs.
items.acceptance: Owned merge/release/incident checks and indicators that the practice is deteriorating.
items.assumption: Synthetic fixtures and component checks are available; representative authorized data, independent review, and production-scale measurements are not assumed.

items.description: Representative quality gates for retrieval, Q&A, citations, abstention, discovery, matching, prices, detectors, sourcing, and drafting.
items.acceptance: Run frozen representative datasets at the populations and thresholds in docs/eval-rubric.md, including slice reports and human adjudication.
items.assumption: Synthetic populations exercise scorecard plumbing only; no representative or production-scale evidence is being claimed.

items.description: Authorization, injection, approval, and audit invariants across independent adversarial cases.
items.acceptance: Run the required authorization and injection populations plus approval concurrency/replay and audit reconciliation with zero hard failures.
items.assumption: Synthetic populations exercise scorecard plumbing only; no representative or production-scale evidence is being claimed.

items.description: Serious-pilot capacity, latency, concurrency, and cost envelope.
items.acceptance: Measure 100,000 documents, 250,000 products, 50 active users, 2 QPS steady load, burst behavior, queue saturation, cost, and p95/p99 objectives.
items.assumption: Synthetic populations exercise scorecard plumbing only; no representative or production-scale evidence is being claimed.

items.description: Private profile, backup/restore, rollback, staged rollout, and soak evidence.
items.acceptance: Run blocked-egress parity, restore/revocation/rollback exercises, and a 14-day soak with no critical integrity or security event.
items.assumption: Synthetic populations exercise scorecard plumbing only; no representative or production-scale evidence is being claimed.

weeks.title: Contracts, evidence, and safe skeleton
weeks.exit_evidence: Boundary review, schema migration, deny-by-default routes, fixture provenance, and evaluation dry run.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Data foundation, ingestion, jobs, and artifacts
weeks.exit_evidence: Extraction benchmark, lineage, idempotency/retry/cancellation, model manifest, withdrawal, and rollback.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Retrieval, grounded Q&A, analytics, and discovery
weeks.exit_evidence: Retrieval ablation, bilingual slices, citation verification, abstention, analytics reconciliation, and hard filters.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Detection, vision, drafting, and review
weeks.exit_evidence: Labeled detector slice, vision precision, rule replay, reviewer exercise, state/concurrency, and audit samples.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Complete journeys and integrations
weeks.exit_evidence: Role journeys, accessibility, session isolation, exports, integration retries, and MCP parity.
weeks.assumption: Core path checks exist, but complete role journeys, accessibility, integration retry evidence, and independent sign-off remain open.

weeks.title: Integration, security, and release automation
weeks.exit_evidence: Threat-model closure, authorization/injection, scans, audit failure, private egress, and rollback rehearsal.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: UAT, serious scale, and recovery
weeks.exit_evidence: UAT disposition, mixed-load p95/p99, queue saturation, recovery, cost, and alert validation.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Staged pilot release and knowledge transfer
weeks.exit_evidence: Signed pilot scorecard, deployment/rollback, smoke tests, training, and open-risk ownership.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Supported operation
weeks.exit_evidence: Seven-day trends, incidents, reviewer calibration, capacity observation, and reruns for promoted fixes.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.

weeks.title: Stabilization and handover
weeks.exit_evidence: Final acceptance, unresolved-item ownership/expiry, recovery/rollback sign-off, and 14-day soak.
weeks.assumption: Exit evidence is incomplete until the linked ledger items have executed artifacts and independent review.
